Map files for the GNSS map (Modem page), served by the router itself so the
map works without any third-party request. Copied unchanged unless noted.

maplibre-gl.js, maplibre-gl.css   MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0 (BSD-3-Clause, LICENSE-maplibre)
pmtiles.js                        pmtiles 4.5.0, dist/pmtiles.js (BSD-3-Clause)
basemaps.js                       @protomaps/basemaps 5.7.2, dist/basemaps.js (BSD-3-Clause):
                                  the map style for Protomaps' OpenStreetMap tiles
fonts/                            Noto Sans Regular/Medium/Italic glyph ranges (Latin, Greek,
                                  Cyrillic, punctuation) from protomaps/basemaps-assets
                                  (SIL Open Font License, fonts/OFL.txt)
sprites/                          Map icons v4 light/dark from protomaps/basemaps-assets
                                  (derived from MIT-licensed tangrams/icons, sprites/LICENSE.md)
countries.geojson                 Natural Earth 1:50m Admin 0 countries (public domain),
                                  reduced to name and code, coordinates rounded to 0.001°

Map data downloaded on the router (Modem page, "Detailed map"): (c) OpenStreetMap
contributors, ODbL, as built by Protomaps.
